mainEntity.name: What is the difference between OEM and ODM?

acceptedAnswer.text: OEM uses the customer's formula; ODM uses our 20 ready SKUs with the customer's label. OEM development is 30-45 days with MOQ 1,000-3,000 bottles; ODM is 25-40 days with MOQ 1,000 sets.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum order quantity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trial order MOQ is 1,000 sets for the bundled sets, which is a sample run and not a commercial order. The price falls as the run gets larger, and each run is quoted for the quantity and the packing you ask for.
Private label production is 25-40 days. A custom formula and a lab sample are 30-45 days. Stability and compatibility testing is a scheduled programme that runs in months and is quoted separately.

mainEntity.name: What payment terms do you accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: 35% T/T deposit + 65% balance before shipment for orders under USD 30,000. L/C at sight for orders at or above USD 30,000. USD/EUR/RMB invoices available.

20 ready SKUs: samples are chargeable and the fee is confirmed in the quotation, buyer pays shipping (USD 30-80 via DHL/FedEx). Custom formula samples: USD 200-500 non-refundable once lab work begins.
Default FOB Guangzhou/Shenzhen per ICC Publication 723E (Incoterms 2020). EXW, FCA, CIF, CFR, DAP, DDP, DPU also available on request.

mainEntity.name: What regulatory compliance do you support?

acceptedAnswer.text: FDA-registered facility (USA), GPSR and the EU responsible-person handover, REACH SVHC declarations, CLP/SDS per Annex II, and BPR 528/2012 for disinfectant SKUs. A pet-only product is not a cosmetic under Regulation (EC) 1223/2009, so there is no CPNP notification and no cosmetic safety report for a pet line; both belong to a human-use line, which is a separate project.

Contracts governed by PRC law. Default arbitration at CIETAC Shanghai (English, 3 arbitrators). For orders USD 100,000+ also available ICC Paris or HKIAC Hong Kong. Awards enforceable in 170+ jurisdictions under the New York Convention 1958.

content.title: OEM vs ODM — Which fits your brand?
content.lead: Both paths lead to your shelf. Here's how to choose.

content.html:
Dimension OEM ODM
Formula Customer provides formula / specs Factory provides ready formulas
Best for Brands with R&D / in-house lab Startups, new entrants, fast launch
Development 30–45 days (formula + sample) 25–40 days (label + packaging)
MOQ 1,000–3,000 bottles 1,000 sets
IP Customer owns formula Factory owns formula
Cost Higher setup, lower unit Lower setup, mid-range unit
Customization Full formula customization Label / packaging customization
Samples Paid samples, 7–14 days Chargeable samples, fee in the quotation, 5–7 days
Compliance Customer-led Factory-led (FDA, ISO, MSDS)

Still not sure which path fits? Talk to our solutions team.
